aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It leans into leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring scanner setups. Be aware that this approach significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage potential rapid losses.

income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It rotates into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index funds for steady monthly distributions, cutting leverage and high-beta names. While prioritizing low drawdown and reliable income, remember that distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
